items.project: THIRD Street creative arts campus - former Downtown Cinemas / Eclipse Theatres (downtown Las Vegas Arts District)
items.location: 814 S. Third St (APN 139-34-401-014), downtown Las Vegas Arts District, Redevelopment Area 1, Ward 3 - verified on the RDA agenda summary
items.status: City of Las Vegas Redevelopment Agency agenda item (Nov 4, 2026) for an Agency Reimbursement Agreement with Third Street, Inc. up to $4.2M; approval reported by Fox5 Nov 5-6. Phase 1A construction targeted within 9 months of the agreement effective date; opening about summer 2028 (tentative).
items.dateConfidence: Construction schedule is the agreement's target/outside dates measured from an effective date not yet known; summer 2028 opening is Fox5 only (tentative).
items.summary: Nonprofit THIRD Street is converting the closed Downtown Cinemas multiplex (formerly Eclipse Theaters, closed Dec 2025) at 814 S. Third St into a performing-arts, education and workforce campus. The first construction package (Phase 1A) combines former Cinemas 1 and 2 into a large flexible studio theatre of about 250 seats, plus a new lobby, public stair, concession and back-of-house support. Phase 1A rough budget $7,470,126; the city RDA reimburses eligible hard costs up to $4.2M, conditional on THIRD Street raising its share (about $3.3M non-RDA).
items.whyItMatters: Adds a new arts and workforce anchor in the Arts District and reuses a long-empty downtown theater building. Answers 'what's happening in the Arts District'. LVINIT has a downtown-arts-district neighborhood page and no coverage of this project.
items.recommendedAngle: What is going into the old downtown movie theater on Third Street: a nonprofit arts and media campus, what the city is paying for, and when it could open.
verifiedFacts: RDA agenda summary (READ, primary): Meeting of Nov 4, 2026; RA-XX-2026 resolution on an Agency Reimbursement Agreement between the City of Las Vegas Redevelopment Agency and Third Street, Inc., adaptive reuse improvements at 814 South Third Street (APN 139-34-401-014); $4,200,000 from RDA Special Revenue Fund; Redevelopment Area 1, Ward 3 (Diaz); related to a Council item; purpose: arts performances, arts education, theatre workforce development and arts-focused community events in the Arts District; staff recommendation Approval.

Draft agreement backup (READ, primary, scanned): Attachment C - Phase 1A is a large flexible studio theatre in former Cinemas 1 and 2 with audience capacity of approximately 250 seats (final specs subject to design, code and permitting), Level 1 lobby, public stair to Levels 2-3, concession, north back-of-house (restrooms, showers, dressing, wardrobe, loading), back-of-house connections.
Attachment E (READ): Phase 1A ROM budget $7,470,126 (hard costs $4,752,512; soft costs 35% $1,663,379; theater equipment $1,054,235); OCMI rough order of magnitude 3.5.26.
Attachment G (READ): construction start target within 9 months of effective date (outside 12 months); substantial completion target 8 months after start (outside 12); closeout within 60-90 days.

Attachment H (READ): THIRD Street fundraising milestones $500K (90 days), about $1.65M (6 months), about $3.3M non-RDA (9 months); reimbursement requires 50% fundraising threshold; a $1M bank line of credit may count in part.
Disclosure (READ): Third Street Inc. is a Nevada nonprofit at 814 S. 3rd St; CEO listed as Darren Weller (Fox5/KNPR call him Daz Weller).
Fox5 (read, Nov 5-6, 2026): approval reported; total $7.4M; city $4.2M; doors projected summer 2028; lease signed end of 2025; education partnerships with high schools, CSN, UNLV.
KNPR (read, Feb 23, 2026): resident companies Vegas Theatre Company, Vegas City Opera, Las Vegas Sinfonietta, Laugh After Dark.

Agreement effective date (drives the construction schedule).
Whole-building size: KNPR 41,500 sq ft vs other reports 52,000; not stated in the agreement. Do not cite.
